name: graphicle
tagline: Maps your repository into a code graph and provides memory for coding agents
description: Graphicle is an open‑source tool that indexes a code repository into a graph, stores project documentation, decisions and past AI coding sessions, and returns cited excerpts to coding agents. It runs locally on macOS, Linux or Windows without requiring Python, Docker or a database server. The tool works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Claude Desktop and any MCP client. No account or telemetry is needed, and updates are optional. It is licensed under Apache‑2.0 and can be installed via Homebrew or a direct script.
best_for: Teams that need private, local code context
Projects requiring searchable documentation and decisions
Agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex
Repositories that want a unified code‑graph and memory serve

free_tier.notes: Runs locally with no account or telemetry required
